title: Create the CFO strategic-finance board deck

output.target_path: Deliverables/FY26 outlook and FY27 priorities board deck - 7.6.pptx

prompt:
Create this file:
`Deliverables/FY26 outlook and FY27 priorities board deck - 7.6.pptx`

Begin with the Q2 board, lender, and investor-relations thread in `Requests/`, including the source-tie follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Create a board-ready 10-slide deck: title; executive decision summary; consolidated forecast versus plan; branch performance; EBITDA bridge; cash and liquidity; leverage and covenant risk; FY27 strategic priorities; decisions and gates; appendix with definitions and source reconciliation. Rebuild operating headlines from branch economics. Compare forecast revenue with the $47.92 million Board-approved AOP, keep the current branch comparator separate, and identify the largest negative branch EBITDA variance. Show Base/Downside/Severe cash and leverage and flag every guardrail breach. Show total probability-weighted priority benefit and the separately executable Approved-plus-Gated amount; distinguish Approved, Gated, Conditional, and Deferred actions. Use editable charts and tables, concise board narrative, page numbers, source footnotes, and consistent units.

Also add an optimized board decision portfolio with cash-budget, count, dependency, and status gates plus Severe-case benefit factors. The pre-action Severe case already breaches cash and leverage even with no initiatives, so show those inherited guardrails as diagnostic decision gates rather than rejecting every portfolio. After selecting the portfolio, draw the remaining revolver only toward the minimum cash floor, cap the draw at remaining commitment, and show the incremental draw, remaining headroom, residual unfunded shortfall, ending cash, and leverage.

Document the controlling sources in the deliverable, recalculate or render the finished file as appropriate, and save it to the exact target path.

Keep the shared company workspace clean: change only the requested target file and do not leave behind draft scripts or temporary exports.
